title: LiDAR Survey — An idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: Sensor view scan
scenes.purpose: Establish the sensor view and build sparse depth returns in pushbroom scan order, coloured by the fixed height legend.
visuals: Three.js point cloud of an illustrative procedural survey (ground, vegetation, buried structure) in a fixed metric frame
Sensor dot with translucent beam fan and scan front line
HEIGHT legend 0–24 m, 20 m ground scale bar, live RETURNS / SWEEP X readout

beats.development: Title, kicker and legend settle; beam switches on at the sensor.
captions: An idea becomes a connected system

beats.development: Scan front sweeps x −40 → 40 m; returns accumulate at their coordinates while the camera begins a slight orbit.
Beam fades; full cloud held unsliced so it can be compared with the slice.

scenes.title: Height slice reveals the system
scenes.purpose: Toggle the 11.0–13.5 m height slice so the buried structure's tops emerge as a hidden connected outline.
visuals: Out-of-band returns dim, in-band returns brighten without changing their legend colour
Slice threshold rectangles at 11.0 and 13.5 m; legend band marker
Projected outline: 5 nodes and 5 links trace over the slice

beats.development: Slice toggles on; legend marker SLICE 11.0–13.5 m appears.
Nodes pop and links trace between them, the central node in the active accent.
Caption settles; orbit eases to rest for a clean reading hold.

findings: Scan fills 1.2 s; deliberate 0.28 s wait before the slice per style timing rule.
All motion settles by 2.5 s; final 0.5 s is a reading hold.

notes: Illustrative procedural point cloud (~13k returns), not measured survey data.
